investigations.name: cellbased-comparison-2017
investigations.title: Reproducing Osborne et al. 2017 cell-based model comparison
investigations.question:
Can pbg-chaste, driving the real Chaste engine through PyChaste, quantitatively
reproduce the cell-sorting results of Osborne et al. (2017) across the paper's
five cell-based modelling classes (CA, CP, OS, VT, VM) — matching a ground-truth
baseline generated by building and running the authors' own C++ code?
investigations.hypothesis:
For the four model classes reachable through mainline PyChaste bindings (CP, OS,
VT, VM), a faithfully-configured pbg-chaste simulation reproduces the fractional
boundary length trajectory of the authors' C++ implementation to within run-to-run
stochastic spread (10 seeds). The CA class is expected to remain unreproducible
without new bindings, because its differential-adhesion switching rule is a custom
class in the paper's repo and PyChaste exposes no constructible abstract base for it.
